parts.text: What can you do, and can you directly modify or merge my repository?
I can inspect bounded GitHub context, assess change risk, and build a validated task contract. I cannot modify repositories, create pull requests, or merge code.
Assess this change: update authentication and production deployment. Expected files: app/auth.py and .github/workflows/deploy.yml.
The deterministic assessment is high risk. It requires security tests, deployment rollback review, secret scanning, independent review, and human merge approval.

Build a contract for noktohq/nokto-agent-orchestrator. Title: Add reproducible test instructions. Goal: document the exact validation command. Allowed paths: README.md and docs/**. Disallowed paths: src/**. Acceptance criteria: README contains a reproducible testing section; no source files change. Tests: pnpm run lint and pnpm run typecheck. Base: main. Implementers: codex and claude. Retries: 1. Timeout: 15 minutes.
Return a validated JSON contract with mustPass true, branchPrefix agent/, human review required, and an explicit statement that no repository change or pull request occurred.
